description: Create a draft that forwards an existing email (with its attachments) to new recipients, with an optional note on top. Nothing is sent; the user reviews the draft in Gmail. Works across accounts: forward from the account that received it, or pass another account to forward from.

account.description: Account alias or email address. Omit to use the default account. No accounts connected yet.

note.description: Text to write above the forwarded message.

sourceAccount.description: Account the message is in (default: the forwarding account).

name: forward_email
title: Forward an email (as a draft)
